title: HomeLane revenues dip to Rs 745 crore in FY26, loss widens to Rs 137 crore
summary: HomeLane revenues dip to Rs 745 crore in FY26, loss widens to Rs 137 crore
detailed: Fiscal year 2026 was HomeLane's first year of operations after integrating with DesignCafe, and the company prioritised profitability over revenue growth, founder Srikanth Iyer told ET.
